resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Functions[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You made it all the way to module 6! Congrats!

Let’s start by talking about functions. You’ve already met and used plenty of [b]functions [/b]( a group of related statements that performs a specific task) by now.

To jog your memory, here are some examples that you've already seen:[code format="py" ][b]print[/b]("Hello world!")
[b]range[/b](2, 20)
[b]str[/b](12)
[b]range[/b](10, 20, 3)[/code]
The words in front of the parentheses are function [b]names[/b], and the comma-separated values inside the parentheses are function [b]arguments[/b].  
[note]Functions help break our program into smaller, modular chunks. As our program gets bigger and more complex, functions help to make it more organized and manageable.[/note]

content.text: 圆括号`()`前面的名字是 **函数名** ，圆括号内用逗号`,`分隔的值是 **函数参数** 。
content.text_html:
The words in front of the parentheses are function names, and the comma-separated values inside the parentheses are function arguments.

圆括号前面的字是函数名，圆括号内用逗号分隔的值是函数参数。

content.text: 函数有助于将我们的程序分成更小的、模块化的块。随着我们的程序越来越大，越来越复杂，函数有助于使它更有组织性和可管理性。
content.text_html:
Functions help break our program into smaller, modular chunks. As our program gets bigger and more complex, functions help to make it more organized and manageable.
